head: codex/5909-lease-authority-defect
title: [v0.92][WP-04.07][defect] Harden lease mutation authority and bounded proof
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5909

## Summary

- Requires lease mutation authorization to match the ledger-owned applied authority-log index.
- Enforces deterministic lineage and prospective snapshot capacity before any state mutation.
- Separates initial LeaseGrant from successor Activate semantics.
- Replaces self-attested negatives with nine machine-derived, digest-bound cases and stream-accurate proof.
